exposure: Diagnosis of Neural Tube Defect (NTD) in midtrimester fetal ultrasound
cohort: The cohort consisted of 69 patients whose fetuses were diagnosed with Neural Tube Defect (NTD) in a midtrimester fetal ultrasound scan and who chose to continue the pregnancy between January 2011 and February 2016.
finding: The study demonstrated that among fetuses with NTD whose pregnancies were continued, 10.1% experienced neonatal death, 92% required meningomyelocele closure, 30.7% developed paraplegia, and 51.6% developed neurogenic bladder.
